```{r setup}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readr)
  library(dplyr)
  library(purrr)
  library(stringr)
  library(tibble)
})

CNV_DIR <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/WGS/PCGR/Downstream/CNV"
files <- sort(list.files(CNV_DIR, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE))

cat("[INFO] CNV_DIR:", CNV_DIR, "\n")
cat("[INFO] CSV files found:", length(files), "\n\n")
if (length(files) == 0) stop("[ERROR] No CSV files found.")

# ---- Read only header line (fast; avoids full parsing) ----
get_cols <- function(f) {
  hdr <- read_lines(f, n_max = 1)
  if (length(hdr) == 0 || nchar(hdr[1]) == 0) {
    return(tibble(file = basename(f), empty = TRUE, ncol = NA_integer_, cols = list(character())))
  }
  cols <- str_split(hdr[1], ",", simplify = FALSE)[[1]] %>% str_trim()
  tibble(file = basename(f), empty = FALSE, ncol = length(cols), cols = list(cols))
}

hdr_df <- map_dfr(files, get_cols)

cat("====================================================\n")
cat("[SANITY] File count + column count\n")
cat("====================================================\n")
print(hdr_df %>% dplyr::select(file, empty, ncol))

if (any(hdr_df$empty)) {
  cat("\n[WARN] Empty files detected:\n")
  print(hdr_df %>% filter(empty) %>% select(file))
}

# ---- Column match check (exact: names + order) ----
ref_cols <- hdr_df %>% dplyr::filter(!empty) %>% dplyr::slice(1) %>% dplyr::pull(cols) %>% .[[1]]
ref_file <- hdr_df %>% dplyr::filter(!empty) %>% dplyr::slice(1) %>% dplyr::pull(file)

cmp_df <- hdr_df %>%
  mutate(
    same_as_ref = map_lgl(cols, ~ identical(.x, ref_cols)),
    missing_vs_ref = map_chr(cols, ~ paste(setdiff(ref_cols, .x), collapse = ";")),
    extra_vs_ref   = map_chr(cols, ~ paste(setdiff(.x, ref_cols), collapse = ";"))
  )

cat("\n====================================================\n")
cat("[SANITY] Column matching vs reference\n")
cat("====================================================\n")
cat("[INFO] Reference file:", ref_file, "\n")
cat("[INFO] Reference columns (ordered):\n")
cat(paste(ref_cols, collapse = ", "), "\n\n")

print(cmp_df %>% dplyr::select(file, same_as_ref))

# Show mismatches with details
mismatch <- cmp_df %>% filter(!empty, !same_as_ref)

if (nrow(mismatch) == 0) {
  cat("\n All non-empty files have identical column names AND order.\n")
} else {
  cat("\n Mismatched files detected (details below):\n\n")
  print(
    mismatch %>%
      transmute(
        file,
        ncol,
        missing_vs_ref = ifelse(missing_vs_ref == "", "NONE", missing_vs_ref),
        extra_vs_ref   = ifelse(extra_vs_ref == "", "NONE", extra_vs_ref)
      )
  )
  cat("\n[NOTE] If column order differs, bind_rows() can still work if names match,\n")
  cat("       but it's safest to standardize order before merging.\n")
}
```


```{r}
# ====================================================
# SANITY: unique gene counts across all CNV CSV files
#   - genes per file (unique SYMBOL)
#   - total unique genes across cohort
#   - genes shared across ALL files
# ====================================================

# Read only what we need (SYMBOL), keep robust trimming
gene_list <- purrr::map(files, function(f) {
  df <- readr::read_csv(f, show_col_types = FALSE, progress = FALSE)

  if (!"SYMBOL" %in% names(df)) {
    stop(paste0("[ERROR] SYMBOL column missing in: ", basename(f)))
  }

  df %>%
    transmute(SYMBOL = stringr::str_trim(as.character(SYMBOL))) %>%
    filter(!is.na(SYMBOL), SYMBOL != "") %>%
    distinct() %>%
    mutate(file = basename(f)) %>%
    select(file, SYMBOL)
})

# ---- Genes per file ----
per_file_genes <- bind_rows(gene_list) %>%
  group_by(file) %>%
  summarise(unique_genes = n_distinct(SYMBOL), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(unique_genes))
```


```{r}
# ---- Total unique genes across all files ----
all_unique_genes <- bind_rows(gene_list) %>%
  distinct(SYMBOL)

cat("\n====================================================\n")
cat("[SUMMARY] Unique genes across ALL files\n")
cat("====================================================\n")
cat("Total unique genes across cohort:", nrow(all_unique_genes), "\n")

# ---- Genes shared in ALL files ----
shared_genes <- Reduce(intersect, lapply(gene_list, function(x) x$SYMBOL))

cat("Genes present in ALL files:", length(shared_genes), "\n")
print(shared_genes)

# ====================================================
# Genes present in at least 5 samples
# ====================================================

# Count in how many samples each gene appears
gene_frequency <- bind_rows(gene_list) %>%
  group_by(SYMBOL) %>%
  summarise(n_samples = n_distinct(file), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(n_samples))

# Filter genes present in >= 5 samples
recurrent_genes_5 <- gene_frequency %>%
  filter(n_samples >= 5)

cat("\n====================================================\n")
cat("[RECURSIVE CNV GENES] Present in ≥ 5 samples\n")
cat("====================================================\n")

print(recurrent_genes_5)

cat("\nTotal genes present in ≥ 5 samples:", nrow(recurrent_genes_5), "\n")

# save lists for downstream
write_tsv(all_unique_genes, file.path(CNV_DIR, "ALL_unique_genes.tsv"))
write_tsv(recurrent_genes_5, file.path(CNV_DIR, "recurrent_genes_min5.tsv"))
```

```{r}
# ====================================================
# DEBUG specific files for gene count discrepancy
# ====================================================

debug_files <- c(
  "JC287-TP17-M11.csv",
  "JC287-TP08-525.csv"
)

for (fname in debug_files) {
  
  cat("\n====================================================\n")
  cat("[DEBUG] File:", fname, "\n")
  cat("====================================================\n")
  
  fpath <- file.path(CNV_DIR, fname)
  df <- readr::read_csv(fpath, show_col_types = FALSE)
  
  cat("Total rows in file:", nrow(df), "\n")
  
  # Raw unique SYMBOL (no cleaning)
  raw_unique <- length(unique(df$SYMBOL))
  cat("Unique SYMBOL (raw):", raw_unique, "\n")
  
  # Cleaned SYMBOL (trim + remove NA/empty)
  clean_symbols <- df$SYMBOL %>%
    as.character() %>%
    stringr::str_trim()
  
  clean_symbols <- clean_symbols[!is.na(clean_symbols) & clean_symbols != ""]
  
  clean_unique <- length(unique(clean_symbols))
  cat("Unique SYMBOL (trimmed, no NA/empty):", clean_unique, "\n")
  
  # Check duplicates
  dup_count <- sum(duplicated(clean_symbols))
  cat("Number of duplicated SYMBOL rows:", dup_count, "\n")
  
  # Show duplicated genes (if any)
  dup_genes <- clean_symbols[duplicated(clean_symbols)] %>% unique()
  
  if (length(dup_genes) > 0) {
    cat("Duplicated genes:\n")
    print(head(dup_genes, 10))
  }
}
```


```{r setup}
# Heat map of recurrent Copy-Number Alterations 
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readr)
  library(dplyr)
  library(purrr)
  library(stringr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ComplexHeatmap)
  library(circlize)
  library(grid)
})
# ====================================================
# INPUTS
# ====================================================
CNV_DIR <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/WGS/PCGR/Downstream/CNV/"
files <- sort(list.files(CNV_DIR, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE))
if (length(files) == 0) stop("[ERROR] No CSV files found in CNV_DIR")

min_samples <- 5

# Colors (as you requested)
class_cols <- c(
  "Hetdel" = "#8C6D31",  # brown
  "Homdel" = "#D7301F",  # red
  "Gain"   = "#31A354",  # green
  "None"   = "#FFFFFF"   # white background
)

# Priority: most severe wins for multiple rows per gene×sample
priority <- c("Homdel" = 3, "Hetdel" = 2, "Gain" = 1, "None" = 0)

normalize_class <- function(x) {
  x <- str_to_lower(str_trim(as.character(x)))
  dplyr::case_when(
    x %in% c("hetdel") ~ "Hetdel",
    x %in% c("homdel") ~ "Homdel",
    x %in% c("gain")   ~ "Gain",
    TRUE               ~ NA_character_
  )
}

```

```{r}
# ====================================================
# Read all CNV files 
# ====================================================

cnv_long <- purrr::map_dfr(files, function(f) {
  df <- readr::read_csv(f, show_col_types = FALSE, progress = FALSE)

  if (!all(c("SYMBOL", "VARIANT_CLASS") %in% names(df))) {
    stop(paste0("[ERROR] Missing required columns in: ", basename(f)))
  }

  df %>%
    transmute(
      Sample = str_replace(basename(f), "\\.csv$", ""),
      SYMBOL = str_trim(as.character(SYMBOL)),
      VARIANT_CLASS = normalize_class(VARIANT_CLASS)
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(SYMBOL), SYMBOL != "", !is.na(VARIANT_CLASS))
})

```
```{r}
# ====================================================
# Collapse to ONE class per gene×sample using severity priority
# ====================================================
cnv_onecall <- cnv_long %>%
  mutate(score = unname(priority[VARIANT_CLASS])) %>%
  group_by(Sample, SYMBOL) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = score, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(Sample, SYMBOL, VARIANT_CLASS)

# ====================================================
# Keep genes present in >= min_samples samples
# ====================================================
gene_freq <- cnv_onecall %>%
  distinct(Sample, SYMBOL) %>%
  count(SYMBOL, name = "n_samples") %>%
  filter(n_samples >= min_samples) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_samples), SYMBOL)

genes_keep <- gene_freq$SYMBOL
cat("[INFO] Genes kept (>= ", min_samples, " samples): ", length(genes_keep), "\n", sep = "")
```
```{r}
# ====================================================
# Make heatmap matrix (genes x samples) with "None" for missing
# ====================================================
samples <- sort(unique(cnv_onecall$Sample))

heat_df <- cnv_onecall %>%
  filter(SYMBOL %in% genes_keep) %>%
  transmute(SYMBOL, Sample, VAR = VARIANT_CLASS)

mat_chr <- heat_df %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Sample, values_from = VAR) %>%
  as.data.frame()

rownames(mat_chr) <- mat_chr$SYMBOL
mat_chr$SYMBOL <- NULL

# Ensure all sample columns exist and in desired order
missing_cols <- setdiff(samples, colnames(mat_chr))
if (length(missing_cols) > 0) mat_chr[missing_cols] <- NA_character_
mat_chr <- mat_chr[, samples, drop = FALSE]

# Fill missing as "None"
mat_chr[is.na(mat_chr)] <- "None"

# Order genes (most recurrent at top)
mat_chr <- mat_chr[genes_keep, , drop = FALSE]

# Convert to matrix + make factor matrix for ComplexHeatmap
mat_chr <- as.matrix(mat_chr)
storage.mode(mat_chr) <- "character"

mat_fac <- matrix(
  factor(as.vector(mat_chr), levels = c("None", "Hetdel", "Homdel", "Gain")),
  nrow = nrow(mat_chr),
  ncol = ncol(mat_chr),
  dimnames = dimnames(mat_chr)
)
```

```{r}
# ====================================================
# Row annotation: stacked barplot counts per gene
# ====================================================
count_mat <- sapply(c("Hetdel", "Homdel", "Gain"), function(cl) rowSums(mat_chr == cl))
colnames(count_mat) <- c("Hetdel", "Homdel", "Gain")

row_ha <- rowAnnotation(
  `Class counts` = anno_barplot(
    count_mat,
    gp = gpar(
      fill = class_cols[colnames(count_mat)],
      col = NA
    ),
    border = FALSE,
    bar_width = 0.95
  ),
  width = unit(2.8, "cm")
)

```

```{r}
# ====================================================
# Heatmap
# ====================================================
show_x_names <- FALSE     # set TRUE to show sample names
column_names_rot <- if (show_x_names) 45 else 0

# Make cells closer to square by matching aspect ratio (rows/cols)
ht_w <- unit(6, "cm")
ht_h <- unit(3 * nrow(mat_fac) / ncol(mat_fac), "cm")

txt_gp_row <- gpar(fontsize = 9, col = "black", fontfamily = "sans")
txt_gp_col <- gpar(fontsize = 9, col = "black", fontfamily = "sans")

ht <- Heatmap(
  mat_fac,
  name = "VARIANT_CLASS",
  col = class_cols,

  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  show_row_dend = FALSE,
  show_column_dend = FALSE,

  show_column_names = show_x_names,
  column_names_rot = column_names_rot,

  row_names_side = "left",
  column_names_side = "bottom",
  row_names_gp = txt_gp_row,
  column_names_gp = txt_gp_col,

  rect_gp = gpar(col = "grey80", lwd = 0.6),
  na_col = class_cols["None"],

  width = ht_w,
  height = ht_h,

  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    at = c("Hetdel", "Homdel", "Gain"),
    labels = c("Hetdel", "Homdel", "Gain"),
    labels_gp = gpar(col = "black", fontsize = 10),
    title_gp  = gpar(col = "black", fontsize = 11, fontface = "bold")
  )
)

draw(
  ht + row_ha,
  heatmap_legend_side = "right",
  annotation_legend_side = "right",
  padding = unit(c(25, 10, 25, 10), "mm")
)
```
